utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center, so I’ll start spreading the word there. If you hear any time updates, let me know and I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — I’ll let you know if I hear any time updates. The main thing left is confirming the pickup plan, so I’ll keep an eye out for that.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good, Sam — thanks for keeping an eye on the pickup plan. Let me know as soon as you hear anything, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — if you’re going by the community center, could you see whether they still need any hand tools or screws? I keep forgetting what’s already been dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure — I’ll stop by the community center and ask if they still need any hand tools or screws.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate it. If they do need anything, just let me know and I’ll see what I can round up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s still looking for a few more hands. I can pass along any new details I hear, especially what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Nell. If you hear what time they need people most, let me know and I’ll work around pickup and school.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely — if I hear the busiest time, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane — just send me the details when you have them, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — I’ll send the details over now. What else do we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly hands on Saturday, and maybe a few tools if folks have them. I can keep it low-key and help with the porch setup too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: The community center works for me, and 10 is fine. I’ll bring gloves and a few tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm—the repair drive is still on for today, right? And if you’re heading by the community center, can you check whether they need anything beyond the front steps and railing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, it’s still on for today. I’ll check with the community center about anything beyond the front steps and railing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got both. I can bring them over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, bring them to the community center on Sunday and we’ll sort the rest there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll bring them to the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I’m happy to help. Just let me know the time and which houses are on the list, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and send you the time plus the house list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Quinn — thanks. Just send the details when you have them, and I’ll be ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s on Sunday now at the community center. What should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo — please bring the repair drive list and any route details you have. I’ll keep tracking it and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll bring the repair drive list and the route details to the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — that would really help. Once we’ve got the drop-off spot and pickup help sorted, I’ll feel much better about it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Pia — it’s now on Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep an eye out for more hands and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — that’s a big relief. If you hear who’s covering pickup, let me know and I can help keep track of the details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll bring it up and see who can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik. Let me know if you hear anything—I might miss it if it gets changed around.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do, Noah. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can send over a hammer and a tape measure—anything else you still need?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mina — that covers the main tools for now. If anything else comes up, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, just keep me posted if you need anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the exact time and which houses are on the list for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’m sorry—I don’t have the exact time or house list, but I do know folks are dropping off donations and spare parts all afternoon. I can swing by later and see if they still need help sorting anything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess. If you can check later, could you let me know the exact time and the houses on the list?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll bring it up and see who can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks — it’s Sunday at the community center now. I’ll bring some gloves and tape.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll bring it up and see who can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mina — if you’re able, could you bring any tools or spare materials you’ve got? I’m still trying to keep track of what we need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, just let me know if anything changes for the repair drive—I’m a bit all over the place, so reminders help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do, Noah — I’ll keep you posted if anything changes for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, it’s Sunday at the community center now. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks for the update, Bo. If you confirm the drop-off spot and pickup plan, I can help fill in the last repair details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s at the community center, and I’m expecting the drop-off there Sunday. I’ll check the pickup plan and let you know if it shifts.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules—just send the time and house list when you have it, and I’ll check the details before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Hana — I don’t have the exact time or house list yet, but I know the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. I’ll pass along the details as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, Sunday at the community center works for me—I’ll wait for the time and house list before I go.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still waiting on the time and place, but I’ll pass along any update I hear as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell — I’m planning it for Saturday at the front porch, and I’ll send the exact time and house list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rey — I’ll keep an ear out and share the time and house list as soon as you send them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can help with the repair drive—what else do we still need?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane — the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center. We may still need a few hands to sort things there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can be there Sunday at the community center to help sort things. Just let me know what time to show up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Of course — I’ll keep track of what we still need and remind you if anything comes up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good. Please just keep me posted on the drop-off spot and any pickup updates so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll keep an eye on the drop-off spot and let you know as soon as I hear about any pickup updates.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll bring both over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — that should cover us for the repair drive. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: See you there, Mara—I’ll have them with me.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll wait for your update and help with whatever’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — I’ll keep you posted, and the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Got it, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. Just let me know what else you still need, and I’ll help if I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Mostly I just need help with the logistics—if you can, please let me know where the drop-off will be and who’s handling pickups.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — where should I send people for drop-off, and who’s handling pickups?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still waiting on the exact time and house list, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear. For now, I’d hold off on digging through the garage.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still on this afternoon, then? I’ll wait for the exact time and house list before I dig anything out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s the plan for this afternoon as far as I know — I’m just still waiting on the exact time and house list. I’ll tell you the moment I get it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m heading by the community center later, so I’ll check whether they still need anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Ira—that helps. If you hear anything after school, let me know and I can work around pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll let you know if I hear anything after school.
